features.description:
The features to update the {link PrecomputedFeatures#featureIdToPrecomputedFeature} with.
If {@link #featureIdToPrecomputedFeature} on this spec is populated, it is used instead.

featureIdToPrecomputedFeature.description:
An optional parameter specifying a map of feature id to feature data to update. If provided, it will be
updated based on `features` and returned. Otherwise, the {@link #featureIdToPrecomputedFeature} of this
{@link PrecomputedFeatures} instance will be updated and returned.

excludeBlacklistedFields.description:
If set to true, the resulting `featureIdToPrecomputedFeature` will not be updated with any fields from `features`
that are blacklisted by {@link PrecomputedFeatures}. If `featureIdToPrecomputedFeature` already contains
blacklisted fields, they will remain unchanged.
